sections.Identity:
- Canonical name: Dual diode SOT-23
- ID: OHM-070  slug: `dual_diode_sot23`
- Category: semiconductor / diode (dual)
- Physical package: PKG-SOT23 (owned by G07), member SOT23 3-lead; JEDEC TO-236AB as printed by Nexperia
- Mounting type: smd
- Aliases: BAV70 / BAV99 / BAW56-type dual diode, SOT-23 dual switching diode
- Common variants: Common cathode (BAV70), series (BAV99), common anode (BAW56 class)
- Class B, priority P1, complexity 2
sections.Physical Dimensions: Package body and leads are owned by PKG-SOT23 (G07); do not re-derive. Nexperia SOT23 outline as read for cross-checking only: D 2.8-3.0 (nom 2.9), E 1.2-1.4 (nom 1.3), A 0.9-1.1, A1 0.1 max, lead width 0.38-0.45, lead thickness 0.09-0.15, lead length 0.45-0.55, lead span 2.1-2.5, pitch 1.9 (pin1-pin2), minimal pitch 0.95. No dimension delta for OHM-070 versus any other 3-pin SOT-23 part.
sections.Geometry: Identical to the PKG-SOT23 3-lead body. Delta: none in geometry. Dual diodes use only the standard 3-lead SOT-23 body; no extra marking geometry (no band, no dot required). Pin 1 is identified by the lead arrangement (two leads on one long side, one on the other) and, if the family generator provides it, an optional pin-1 dot decal; marking text (e.g. 'A7', 'JY') is decal only and differs by maker.
sections.Leads / Pins / Terminals: Per PKG-SOT23 (G07). Architecture rule: pins 1-2 on the -Y side with pin 1 at -X, pin 3 on the +Y side. Contact centers copied from G07's final PKG-SOT23 section (second pass): pin 1 (-0.95, -1.0), pin 2 (+0.95, -1.0), pin 3 (0, +1.0), i.e. |y| = 1.0 for the 3-lead member (G07: DERIVED from the Diodes land pattern center-to-center 2.0 and HE/2 - foot/2 = 1.03). The first-pass 0.9 is superseded. Pin usage deltas: COMMON CATHODE (Nexperia BAV70 SOT23): pin 1 anode (diode 1), pin 2 anode (diode 2), pin 3 common cathode. SERIES (Nexperia BAV99 SOT23): pin 1 anode (diode 1), pin 2 cathode (diode 2), pin 3 cathode of diode 1 joined with anode of diode 2. COMMON ANODE (BAW56): pin 1 cathode (k1), pin 2 cathode (k2), pin 3 common anode, from the Philips datasheet 'High-speed double diode BAW56' dated 2003 Mar 25 pinning table (opened second pass; Nexperia's own BAW56_SER PDF URL returned 404, so the Philips-era copy is the evidence, M confidence, since a manufacturer datasheet from the same device lineage that Nexperia inherited). Pinning of the three configurations therefore: BAV70 (1=A1, 2=A2, 3=common K), BAV99 (1=A1, 2=K2, 3=K1/A2), BAW56 (1=K1, 2=K2, 3=common A).
sections.PCB Interface: Per PKG-SOT23: smd_pads, origin FCO = center of the three-pad pattern. Pin 1 at (-0.95, -1.0). OHM-070 adds no footprint difference.
sections.Materials: As PKG-SOT23: body MAT_EPOXY_BLACK, leads MAT_TIN_BRIGHT.
sections.Appearance: Black SOT-23 body, leads bright tin. All three internal configurations are PHYSICALLY IDENTICAL; they differ only by printed marking code and pin function. Default OHMNI configuration for the generic entry: common cathode (BAV70 pinout); all three pin mappings are now sourced.
sections.Orientation Markings: No cathode band. Pin 1 location follows the architecture SOT-23 rule (pin 1 at -X on the -Y side). Polarity is carried by the pin-to-function table above, not by a physical mark.
sections.Recognition Features:
1. Standard 3-lead SOT-23 silhouette (inherited from PKG-SOT23)
2. Optionally a pin-1 dot/marking decal
3. Marking code decal
sections.Parametric Variants: Parameter `configuration`: common_cathode | series | common_anode (metadata only; geometry unchanged). Coupled: none.
sections.Recommended Base Geometry: Delegate to PKG-SOT23 generator (G07). No additional primitives.
sections.Modeling Procedure:
1. Call the PKG-SOT23 3-lead generator with the standard SOT23 member.
2. Attach metadata `configuration` and the pin-function table.
3. Optional marking decal.
sections.LOD Strategy: As PKG-SOT23 (G07).
sections.Simplification Rules: As PKG-SOT23. Nothing specific to OHM-070 may be omitted or added; geometry is shared.
sections.Sources:
1. Nexperia SOT23 package outline (https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/package-information/SOT23.pdf), issue 14-09-22 as extracted. S2. D, E, A, A1, c, w, Lp, B, pitch values; JEDEC TO-236AB.
2. Nexperia BAV70 series datasheet (https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/data-sheet/BAV70_SER.pdf), Rev. 8, 18 March 2015. S3. Pinning table for common cathode.
3. Nexperia BAV99 series datasheet (https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/data-sheet/BAV99_SER.pdf), Rev. 8, 18 November 2010. S3. Pinning for series configuration.
5. Philips Semiconductors, 'High-speed double diode BAW56', datasheet dated 2003 Mar 25 (https://sy-dep-epc-lpc.web.cern.ch/components/datasheets/epc-lpc%20(converters)/Deleted/BAW56%20(PHILIPS).pdf, hosted copy). S3/S4. Pinning table: 1 cathode (k1), 2 cathode (k2), 3 common anode.
6. G07 PKG-SOT23 final section (this spec, second pass 2026-10-02): contact |y| = 1.0 for SOT23-3, x = -0.95, 0, +0.95.
4. Panjit BAW56 series datasheet (https://pdf.direnc.net/upload/baw56-sot23-150ma-100v-diyot-datasheet.pdf and panjit.com.tw BAV70 PDF, REV.03S 19 Jul 2017): configuration drawings (common anode/cathode/series); no pin labels.

Leads emerge from the long sides at Z about 2.03, run outward to X = +-3.81, bend down; the shoulder (wide section b1) ends at Z = 0 (seating plane); the tail narrows to b and extends below the board.
sections.Leads / Pins / Terminals: 6 leads, 3 per row, flat stamped blades, matte tin over copper alloy. Lead axis x = -3.81 (left row, pins 1..3, y descending from +2.540 in 2.54 steps) and x = +3.81 (right row, pins 4..6, y ascending from -2.540). Pin 1 at (-3.81, +2.540). Shoulder b1 1.52 (corner leads may be narrower); tail b 0.46 x c 0.25; tail tip Z = -2.6 (arch default; the drawing L of about 3.30 would reach -3.30 before clinch or trim). Lead-center span per row 5.08.
sections.PCB Interface: THT holes at pitch 2.54, row spacing 7.62, N = 6; drill diameter is footprint domain (RESEARCH_REQUIRED here). Body underside at Z = 0.38 (shoulders rest on the board). FCO origin = center of hole pattern = body center. Pin-1 at (-3.81, +2.540). tail_below_board_top_mm 2.6 (default).
sections.Materials: - Body: MAT_EPOXY_BLACK (alt MAT_EPOXY_DARKGRAY). Leads: MAT_TIN_MATTE (default) or MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Laser-mark decal tint #6E6E70. No new tokens.
sections.Appearance: Black to dark gray epoxy, semi-matte; leads bright or matte tin. Laser-marked text (part number, date code, logo) as a decal on the top face, reading along Y. Manufacturer variation: body color, dimple position, surface texture. Notch and dimple are geometry; text is decal.
sections.Orientation Markings: Semicircular notch at the +Y short end (X=0) AND a dimple near pin 1 at the (-X, +Y) corner; pin 1 top-left at rotation 0, counter-clockwise numbering (left row downward, right row upward).
sections.Recognition Features: 1. Two parallel rows of 3 leads at 2.54 pitch. 2. Row spacing 7.62 (narrow vs wide impression). 3. Long black block with end notch. 4. Wide upper lead shoulder narrowing to a thin tail. 5. Body standoff above the board.
sections.Parametric Variants: Safe: pin_count (generator accepts even 4-64), row_spacing {7.62, 15.24} (10.16 not researched), body_length, body_thickness, tail_length, corner_lead_slim. Coupled: D >= (N/2 - 1) x 2.54 + b1; eA drives lead X; E1 < eA - c.
sections.Recommended Base Geometry: Box (body) + notch cylinder cut + dimple; per lead one extruded flat profile (stub, shoulder, tail) mirrored left/right; linear array along Y at 2.54.
sections.Modeling Procedure: 1. Body box centered at origin, Z 0.38..3.68. 2. Cut end notch and dimple at +Y end. 3. Build one lead: stub at mid-thickness from the body side to X = row, shoulder b1 down to Z=0, tail b down to Z=-2.6. 4. Array 3 per row at 2.54; mirror to the right row; number counter-clockwise. 5. Apply materials and marking decal.

- Category: ic; Subcategory: msop
- Physical package: PKG-MSOP.MSOP-8
- Mounting type: smd
- Aliases: MSOP-8
- Common variants: exposed-pad variants exist (not default)
- Class B; priority P1; complexity 2
sections.Physical Dimensions:
Family table: PKG-MSOP. Member values restated (mm):
- Pins N = 8; pitch 0.65 BSC; body length D 3.0 (2.95-3.05); body width E 3.0 (2.95-3.05); lead span H 4.9 (4.65-5.15).
- A1 standoff 0.1 (0.05-0.15); body thickness A2 0.85 (RESEARCH_REQUIRED, placeholder 0.85); overall 0.95 (A max 1.1); lead width b 0.3 (0.25-0.36); lead thickness c 0.15 (0.09-0.20); foot length L 0.55 (0.40-0.70).
- JEDEC outline: MO-187-AA (Renesas M8.118, ADI RM-8 as printed).
- Basis/confidence: D MFR_DRAWING (H); other values MFR_DRAWING, M (the default is the OHMNI choice inside the opened range).
sections.Geometry: Body block 3.0 (Y) x 3.0 (X) x 0.85 (Z) from Z = 0.1 to Z = 0.95, centered on the pad pattern (body_offset 0,0). Top/bottom draft (OHMNI default 5 deg, LOD2). Pin-1 dimple dia 0.6, depth 0.1, on the top face near the (-X, +Y) corner (inset about 0.8 from both body edges; exact inset is an OHMNI default). Mold-parting line at mid-thickness (LOD2). Gull-wing leads exit the long sides at Z about 0.53, run down a short sloped leg, then a flat foot on Z=0 with tip at X = +-2.45. Square 3.00 x 3.00 body; exposed-pad MSOP-8-EP variants exist (ADI RH-8 appeared in search, not opened).
sections.Leads / Pins / Terminals: 8 gull-wing leads, 4 per row, rectangular section b x c = 0.3 x 0.15, matte tin. Foot flat length 0.55 from the tip; contact center x = +-2.175. Left row pins 1..4 at x = -2.175, y = +0.975 descending by 0.65; right row pins 5..8 at x = +2.175, y ascending from -0.975. Pin 1 = (-2.175, +0.975). Lead-center y span 1.950. Foot angle 0 deg (drawings allow 0-8 deg).
sections.PCB Interface: SMD pads (footprint domain). FCO = pad-pattern center = body center. Lead feet on Z=0; body underside at standoff 0.1. Pin-1 at (-2.175, +0.975). No thermal pad (exposed-pad variants exist: note only, not default).
sections.Materials: - Body: MAT_EPOXY_BLACK (alt MAT_EPOXY_DARKGRAY). Leads: MAT_TIN_MATTE (default) or MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Laser-mark decal tint #6E6E70. No new tokens.
sections.Appearance: Black epoxy, slightly matte, laser-mark text (part number, date code) as a decal; matte-tin leads. Manufacturer variation: body color (black to dark gray), dimple vs bevel, mark text. Dimple is geometry; text is decal.
sections.Orientation Markings: Round dimple on the top face near pin 1 (top-left at rotation 0). Some manufacturers use a beveled pin-1 end edge or a molded notch instead; Renesas notes a 'visual index' is required when the optional chamfer is absent. Pin 1 top-left, counter-clockwise numbering.
sections.Recognition Features: 1. Two rows of 4 gull-wing leads at 0.65 pitch. 2. Flat black body with pin-1 dimple. 3. Lead span 4.9 vs body width 3.0 (tips protrude 0.95 each side). 4. Visible standoff gap. 5. Row-to-row symmetry.
sections.Parametric Variants: Safe: pin_count (even), pitch, body_length, body_width, lead_span, standoff, lead_width, foot_length, body_thickness, exposed_pad (bool, off). Coupled: D >= span + b; H > E + 2 x leg run; foot x = H/2 - L/2; pin1_y = (N/2-1) x pitch / 2.
sections.Recommended Base Geometry: Box (body) + dimple; per lead a 3-segment polyline extruded to rectangular section (exit stub, sloped leg, flat foot), mirrored across the Y axis; linear array along Y.
sections.Modeling Procedure: 1. Body box Z 0.1..0.95, centered. 2. Dimple at pin-1 corner. 3. Lead profile: stub from body side at Z 0.53, leg down to Z=0, foot outward to X = H/2. 4. Array 4 per row at 0.65; mirror for the right row; number counter-clockwise from top-left. 5. Apply MAT_EPOXY_BLACK / MAT_TIN_MATTE and marking decal.
sections.LOD Strategy: LOD0: body box + two merged foot bars. LOD1: individual leads with leg and foot, dimple. LOD2: lead bend radii (about 0.1), draft, parting-line step, edge chamfers.
sections.Simplification Rules: May omit: draft, parting line, bend radii, dimple (LOD0). NEVER omit: lead count/pitch, lead span (tips outside body), standoff, pin-1 corner cue.
sections.Sources:
- Renesas M8.118 8-lead mini small outline (S2), https://www.renesas.com/package-image/pdf/outdrawing/m8.118.pdf; MO-187-AA printed; D 3.0, E 4.9, E1 3.0, e 0.65, A max 1.10, L 0.55 +-0.15, b 0.25-0.36.
- Analog Devices, 8-Lead MSOP (RM-8) (S2), https://wcm-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/en/package-pcb-resources/package/pkg_pdf/msoprm/rm_8.pdf, revision string as printed 10-0-07-20-09-B; MO-187-AA printed; 3.00 x 3.00 body, span 4.65-5.15, height 1.10 max, standoff 0.05-0.15, coplanarity 0.10 (labels partly scrambled).
sections.Research Confidence:
Dimensions: MEDIUM / Geometry: MEDIUM / Materials-appearance: MEDIUM. A2 (body thickness) not found in the opened extractions; placeholder 0.85 within A max 1.10. Evidence note: sources were read via text extraction, several with scrambled labels (flagged in Sources); foot length, A1, c and draft are OHMNI defaults inside opened ranges; dimple shape/position is common practice.

Validation: span 1.950 + b 0.3 = 2.250 <= D 3.0; pin-1 y 0.975 = (N/2-1) x pitch/2; contact x = 4.9/2 - 0.55/2 = 2.175 < H/2; overall height 0.95 <= A max 1.1; numbering per arch Sec. 6; JEDEC numbers only as printed in cited documents.

uncertain_values: body_thickness 0.85 mm is RESEARCH_REQUIRED in the family and entry narrative; overall 0.95 = 0.10 + 0.85.

sections.Physical Dimensions: Instance of PKG-SOT23 (owner G07, final section as of the second pass 2026-10-02); values copied, not re-derived. SOT23-5 member: body length D 2.9 (2.7-3.1), body width E 1.6 (1.3-1.7), overall height A 1.1 (0.9-1.3), standoff A1 0.05 (0.013-0.10), pitch 0.95, lead-tip span HE 3.0, lead width b 0.38 (0.35-0.50), lead thickness c 0.15 (0.10-0.20), foot length 0.40 (0.35-0.55), lead contact center |y| = 1.2 (range 1.2-1.3; G07 DERIVED from the Diodes SOT25 land pattern 2.4 center-to-center). Basis per G07: CONSENSUS / MFR_DRAWING, confidence M. Cross-check from the ADI RJ-5 drawing: pitch 0.95 BSC; body about 2.80-3.00 x 1.50-1.70; JEDEC MO-178-AA as printed.
sections.Geometry: Use PKG-SOT23 body and gull-wing geometry unchanged. IC-style deltas only: (1) 5 leads instead of 3 (center top lead omitted); (2) the top face is a laser-mark area with a pin-1 dot/dimple at the pin-1 corner; (3) same-size leads on all populated positions (no wider tab lead); (4) optional beveled/notched pin-1 edge is manufacturer-specific, default none.
sections.Leads / Pins / Terminals: 5 gull-wing leads at 0.95 pitch, three along the -Y side (positions x = -0.95, 0, +0.95) and 2 along the +Y side. Pins: 1 (-0.95, -1.2), 2 (0, -1.2), 3 (+0.95, -1.2), 4 (+0.95, +1.2), 5 (-0.95, +1.2). Contact x values are +-0.95 / 0; contact |y| = 1.2 (G07 PKG-SOT23 final). Pin 1 = (-0.95, -1.2). Position (0, +y) is empty (no lead).
sections.PCB Interface: SMD pads per PKG-SOT23 / footprint domain; FCO = pad-pattern center = body center; body standoff per PKG-SOT23; no thermal pad.
sections.Materials: - Body: MAT_EPOXY_BLACK (alt MAT_EPOXY_DARKGRAY). Leads: MAT_TIN_MATTE (default) or MAT_TIN_BRIGHT. Laser-mark decal tint #6E6E70. No new tokens.
sections.Appearance: Black epoxy, matte, laser-marked 1-2 line code (decal). Leads matte tin. Marking text is a decal only. Pin-1 dot (decal or 0.3 mm dimple) near the pin-1 corner. Manufacturer variation: dot vs no dot (many SOT-23 ICs mark pin 1 only by the bottom-left lead position and the text orientation).
sections.Orientation Markings: Pin 1 at the (-X, -Y) bottom-left corner when text reads upright (top view, +X right, +Y up): leads 1,2,3 along the bottom, counter-clockwise numbering (arch Sec. 6, 3-lead/SOT-23 rule). The ADI RJ-5 drawing labels pin 1 ('PIN 1 INDICATOR' printed on RJ-6).
sections.Recognition Features: 1. 5 leads in 3 + 2 arrangement. 2. 0.95 pitch. 3. Pin-1 dot at bottom-left. 4. Small black body with the center top lead absent.
sections.Parametric Variants: Parameters inherited from PKG-SOT23 plus pin_count in {5, 6} and mark_dot (bool). Coupled: lead positions on 0.95 grid; pin 5 omitted when N=5.
sections.Recommended Base Geometry: Instance PKG-SOT23 generator with lead mask; add pin-1 dimple.
sections.Modeling Procedure: 1. Instantiate PKG-SOT23 body. 2. Place leads at x = -0.95, 0, +0.95 on -Y side; on +Y side at +0.95, -0.95 (center omitted for N=5). 3. Add dimple at pin 1. 4. Apply materials, decal.
sections.LOD Strategy: LOD0: PKG-SOT23 LOD0 with lead mask. LOD1: individual leads, dot. LOD2: per PKG-SOT23 LOD2.
sections.Simplification Rules: May omit: dimple, draft. NEVER omit: lead count/positions (5 vs 6), pin-1 corner.
sections.Sources:
- (gap-fill) G07 PKG-SOT23 final section of this spec (pass 2, 2026-10-02): D, E, A, A1, HE, b, c, foot, contact |y|; see its family sources (Nexperia SOT753/SOT457, Diodes SOT25/SOT26).
- Analog Devices, 5-Lead SOT-23 (RJ-5) (S2), https://wcm-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/en/package-pcb-resources/package/pkg_pdf/sot-23rj/rj_5.pdf, rev. 11-01-2010-A; MO-178-AA printed; pitch 0.95 BSC; body 2.80-3.00 x 1.50-1.70; pin 1 labelled in the drawing.
sections.Research Confidence:
Dimensions: MEDIUM (copied from G07's final PKG-SOT23 section, which in turn rests on Nexperia, Diodes Inc and Microchip drawings) / Geometry: MEDIUM / Materials-appearance: MEDIUM. IC-specific deltas kept: pin-1 dot/dimple, laser-mark area, lead mask (center +Y lead omitted for N=5). Status complete. Convention note (resolved by G07, which follows the SOT-23 specific sentence of Section 6): arch Sec. 6 lists SOT-23 under the dual-row rule (rows parallel to Y, pin 1 top-left) AND under the 3-lead rule (pins 1-2 on -Y side, pin 1 at -X). These disagree by a 90 deg rotation; this entry follows the SOT-23 specific line (rows along X, pin 1 bottom-left). G07 and this entry now agree (pin 1 at (-0.95, -1.2)).

Validation: pitch 0.95 x 2 = 1.90 between outer leads (<= body length about 2.9); pin count 5 vs listed positions; pin 1 bottom-left, ccw numbering (Pins: 1 (-0.95, -1.2), 2 (0, -1.2), 3 (+0.95, -1.2), 4 (+0.95, +1.2), 5 (-0.95, +1.2).).
